summary: Iteration 7 — Admin Settings (Resend email config + reset-pilot guard), PWA assets & manifest, install-app-button on sidebar, and i18n content translation on Ebooks (EN/ES/PT). All 13 backend pytest tests pass and all frontend flows pass end-to-end. reset-pilot NOT executed (only 400 path + button-enable/disable UI verified).
critical_code_review_comments: index.html declares theme-color twice (#000000 then #7C3AED). The first one wins on some browsers; consider removing the black one for consistent PWA theming.

AdminSettings.jsx allows saving sender_email with an empty resend_api_key and the sender is persisted correctly; however the 'test' button is only enabled when email_configured=true, which is good UX.

reset_pilot in routes_ops.py wipes 'campaigns','partners','influencers','users' etc — irreversible; UI correctly gates it behind the exact 'ZERAR' input. Consider adding a second confirm modal for defense-in-depth.
InstallAppButton hides itself in standalone mode (window.matchMedia). Cannot render on server-side but that's fine for CRA.
mailer.load_settings sensibly falls back to env RESEND_API_KEY / SENDER_EMAIL if DB doc is missing, and 'onboarding@resend.dev' default sender.
seed_data_creation: Persisted sender_email='ןןClub <x@y.com>' then overwritten to 'ןןClub <no-reply@club.com>' in settings collection via test flow. No Resend key stored (empty). demo_disabled remains false (reset NOT executed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 7 features fully verified: (1) GET/POST /api/admin/settings + /email/test → 502 without key, 400 for invalid 'abc' key, sender-only save OK; (2) POST /api/admin/reset-pilot with confirm!='ZERAR' → 400 (never send 'ZERAR' from tests); (3) /manifest.json, /icon-192.png, /icon-512.png, /sw.js all 200; <link rel=manifest> and theme-color present; (4) install-app-button visible in both influencer & admin sidebars and shows informative toast; (5) i18n content on /ebooks — lang-en: Spain/Hotels/Lisbon/Premium; lang-es: España/Hoteles; lang-pt: Espanha. Regression (login 3 roles, /dashboard/influencer, /public/coupon/ROBSON-LUXE-25) all pass.
